     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAwaySpanGlue
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Pushing an away cover forward along an algebra map
    10	
    11	The `pull_naturality` field of `DivRepAffinePullback` compares the forward map at `A` with
    12	the forward map at `B` along a `k`-algebra map `φ : A →ₐ[k] B`.  The forward map is built
    13	from an atlas factorization over a spanning family `f : Fin m → A`, so naturality needs the
    14	*pushed* family `φ ∘ f : Fin m → B` and the induced comparison of carriers.
    15	
    16	This file supplies that transport, at the canonical carriers, over `k`:
    17	
    18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.awayPush` — the induced `k`-algebra map
    19	  `Localization.Away a →ₐ[k] Localization.Away (φ a)`, i.e. mathlib's
    20	  `Localization.awayMap` upgraded over the base field.  Characterized by
    21	  `awayPush_algebraMap`.
    22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.awayPush_comp_toAlgHom` — the square with the two structure
    23	  maps: pushing forward after restricting to `Localization.Away a` is restricting to
    24	  `Localization.Away (φ a)` after `φ`.  This is the identity that turns naturality of the
    25	  forward map into a statement about the pushed cover.
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.span_range_map_eq_top` — the pushed family still spans, so
    27	  it is again an admissible cover.
    28	
    29	Nothing here mentions divisors: it is the localization bookkeeping the naturality field
    30	needs, isolated so that the naturality proof itself reads as a comparison of glued values.
    31	-/
    32	
    33	set_option autoImplicit false
    34	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    35	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    36	
    37	universe u
    38	
    39	open CategoryTheory
    40	
    41	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    42	
    43	namespace DivFamZar
    44	
    45	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    46	variable {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    47	
    48	/-! ## The pushed carrier
    49	
    50	**This is mathlib's map, not ours.**  `Localization.awayMapₐ`
    51	(`Mathlib/RingTheory/Localization/Away/Basic.lean`) already gives
    52	`Localization.Away a →ₐ[R] Localization.Away (f a)` for `f : A →ₐ[R] B` over an arbitrary
    53	base ring `R`, which is exactly the transport this lane needs at `R := k`.  An earlier draft
    54	of this file re-derived it from the `RingHom`-level `Localization.awayMap` by supplying
    55	`commutes'` by hand; a fresh-context review caught the duplication.  What remains here is the
    56	naturality square, which mathlib does not state in the `IsScalarTower.toAlgHom` spelling the
    57	`DivFamZar` statements use. -/
    58	
    59	/-- **The characterizing property of the pushed carrier map**: on the image of `A`,
    60	`Localization.awayMapₐ φ a` is `φ` followed by the structure map of the pushed carrier. -/
    61	@[simp]
    62	theorem awayMapₐ_algebraMap (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (a : A) (x : A) :
    63	    Localization.awayMapₐ φ a (algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) x)
    64	      = algebraMap B (Localization.Away (φ a)) (φ x) := by
    65	  simp [Localization.awayMapₐ, IsLocalization.Away.mapₐ, IsLocalization.Away.map]
    66	
    67	/-- **The naturality square of the away carriers**: restricting to `Localization.Away a` and
    68	then pushing forward along `φ` is the same as applying `φ` and then restricting to
    69	`Localization.Away (φ a)`.  This is the identity that converts `pull_naturality` into a
    70	comparison over the pushed cover, and it is the one thing here that mathlib does not already
    71	state — its `awayMapₐ` lemmas are in the `algebraMap A (Localization.Away a)` spelling, while
    72	the `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom` statements consume `IsScalarTower.toAlgHom`. -/
    73	theorem awayMapₐ_comp_toAlgHom (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (a : A) :
    74	    (Localization.awayMapₐ φ a).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (Localization.Away a))
    75	      = (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B (Localization.Away (φ a))).comp φ :=
    76	  AlgHom.ext fun x => awayMapₐ_algebraMap φ a x
    77	
    78	/-! ## The pushed cover is a cover -/
    79	
    80	/-- **The pushed family still spans**: the image of a spanning family under a ring
    81	homomorphism spans the unit ideal of the target, so an away cover pushes forward to an away
    82	cover. -/
    83	theorem span_range_map_eq_top {ι : Type} (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (f : ι → A)
    84	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤) :
    85	    Ideal.span (Set.range fun t => φ (f t)) = ⊤ := by
    86	  have himg : Ideal.map φ.toRingHom (Ideal.span (Set.range f))
    87	      = Ideal.span (Set.range fun t => φ (f t)) := by
    88	    rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    89	    rfl
    90	  rw [← himg, hspan, Ideal.map_top]
    91	
    92	end DivFamZar
    93	
    94	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-

     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveSpread
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAwayPush
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Descent of the admissible away-local divisor family
    11	
    12	The Noetherian spreading theorem applies after descending a cocycle datum to a finitely
    13	generated subalgebra.  Its two principal localizations are pushed back to the original base,
    14	where they form an etale algebra carrying the same widened divisor family.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    19	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	open AlgebraicJacobian
    28	
    29	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    30	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    31	
    32	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    36	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    37	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    38	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    39	
    40	set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
    41	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
    42	/-- An admissible fibre of a cocycle datum over an arbitrary affine base lifts to a widened
    43	divisor family after an etale base change, with a chosen prime above the input prime. -/
    44	theorem exists_etale_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre
    45	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    46	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) (n g : ℕ)
    47	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    48	    (hgn : g ≤ n)
    49	    (hdeg : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra B K]
    50	      [IsScalarTower k B K],
    51	      classDeg K (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B K) D.cechPicClass) =
    52	        (n : ℤ))
    53	    (p : PrimeSpectrum B)
    54	    (hp : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    55	    ∃ (S : Type u) (_ : CommRing S) (_ : Algebra k S) (_ : Algebra B S)
    56	      (_ : IsScalarTower k B S) (_ : Algebra.Etale B S)
    57	      (q : PrimeSpectrum S),
    58	      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B S) q = p ∧
    59	        ∃ F : DivFamZarAff C S n,
    60	          F.picClass = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B S) D.cechPicClass := by
    61	  obtain ⟨B₀, -, hnoeth, D₀, hbc⟩ := D.exists_fg_isNoetherianRing_baseChange_eq
    62	  letI : IsNoetherianRing (↑B₀) := hnoeth
    63	  let phi : (↑B₀) →ₐ[k] B := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (↑B₀) B
    64	  let p₀ : PrimeSpectrum (↑B₀) :=
    65	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap (↑B₀) B) p
    66	  have hcom : p₀.asIdeal = p.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap (↑B₀) B) := rfl
    67	  let rho : p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[k] p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    68	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p₀.asIdeal p.asIdeal phi hcom
    69	  letI : Algebra p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    70	    rho.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    71	  haveI : IsScalarTower k p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    72	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (rho.commutes x).symm
    73	  haveI : IsScalarTower (↑B₀) p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField
    74	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    75	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
    76	      change algebraMap (↑B₀) p.asIdeal.ResidueField x =
    77	        rho (algebraMap (↑B₀) p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField x)
    78	      rw [Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ_apply, Ideal.ResidueField.map_algebraMap]
    79	      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (↑B₀) B p.asIdeal.ResidueField x
    80	  have hclp : Scheme.CechPic.map
    81	      (relCurveMap C (↑B₀) p.asIdeal.ResidueField) D₀.cechPicClass =
    82	      Scheme.CechPic.map
    83	        (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass := by
    84	    rw [D.descent_cechPicClass hbc,
    85	      ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp]
    86	  have hpD₀ : D₀.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    87	    (D₀.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq
    88	      D p.asIdeal.ResidueField hclp).mpr hp
    89	  have hp₀ : D₀.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    90	    (D₀.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
    91	      p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField).mpr hpD₀
    92	  have hcurve : (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap rho).left =
    93	      relCurveMap C p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
    94	    refine congrArg
    95	      (fun t : overSpec k p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⟶
    96	        overSpec k p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField => (C ◁ t).left) ?_
    97	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
    98	  have hclass : Scheme.CechPic.map
    99	      (relCurveMap C p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   100	        (Scheme.CechPic.map
   101	          (relCurveMap C (↑B₀) p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   102	          D₀.cechPicClass) =
   103	      Scheme.CechPic.map
   104	        (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass := by
   105	    rw [D.descent_cechPicClass hbc,
   106	      ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp,
   107	      ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp, relCurveMap_comp]
   108	  have hinv := classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition C rho
   109	    (Scheme.CechPic.map
   110	      (relCurveMap C (↑B₀) p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField) D₀.cechPicClass)
   111	  rw [hcurve] at hinv
   112	  have hdeg₀ : classDeg p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField
   113	      (Scheme.CechPic.map
   114	        (relCurveMap C (↑B₀) p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   115	        D₀.cechPicClass) = (n : ℤ) := by
   116	    calc
   117	      _ = classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   118	          (Scheme.CechPic.map
   119	            (relCurveMap C p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   120	            (Scheme.CechPic.map
   121	              (relCurveMap C (↑B₀) p₀.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   122	              D₀.cechPicClass)) := hinv.symm
   123	      _ = classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   124	          (Scheme.CechPic.map
   125	            (relCurveMap C B p.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass) := by
   126	        rw [hclass]
   127	      _ = (n : ℤ) := hdeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   128	  obtain ⟨h, hh, q₁, hq₁, f, hf, q₂, hq₂, F₀, hF₀⟩ :=
   129	    D₀.exists_away_away_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre
   130	      hpi n g hchi hgn p₀ hp₀ hdeg₀
   131	  let B₁ := Localization.Away (phi h)
   132	  let phi₁ : Localization.Away h →ₐ[k] B₁ := Localization.awayMapₐ phi h
   133	  let S := Localization.Away (phi₁ f)
   134	  let phi₂ : Localization.Away f →ₐ[k] S := Localization.awayMapₐ phi₁ f
   135	  let algBS : Algebra B S :=
   136	    ((algebraMap B₁ S).comp (algebraMap B B₁)).toAlgebra
   137	  letI : Algebra B S := algBS
   138	  letI : SMul B S := algBS.toSMul
   139	  haveI towerBB₁S : IsScalarTower B B₁ S :=
   140	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
   141	  haveI towerkBS : IsScalarTower k B S :=
   142	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   143	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.comp_assoc,
   144	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k B B₁,
   145	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k B₁ S])
   146	  letI : Algebra.Etale B B₁ := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway (phi h)
   147	  letI : Algebra.Etale B₁ S := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway (phi₁ f)
   148	  letI : Algebra.Etale B S := Algebra.Etale.comp B B₁ S
   149	  have hph : phi h ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   150	    intro hmem
   151	    apply hh
   152	    exact hmem
   153	  obtain ⟨q₁B, hq₁B⟩ : p ∈ Set.range
   154	      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B₁)) := by
   155	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range B₁ (phi h)]
   156	    exact hph
   157	  have hq₁push : PrimeSpectrum.comap phi₁.toRingHom q₁B = q₁ := by
   158	    apply PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_injective
   159	      (Localization.Away h) (Submonoid.powers h)
   160	    change PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap (↑B₀) (Localization.Away h))
   161	        (PrimeSpectrum.comap phi₁.toRingHom q₁B) =
   162	      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap (↑B₀) (Localization.Away h)) q₁
   163	    rw [← Function.comp_apply, ← PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp]
   164	    have hsquare := DivFamZar.awayMapₐ_comp_toAlgHom phi h
   165	    rw [congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hsquare, PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp]
   166	    change PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap (↑B₀) B)
   167	        (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B₁) q₁B) = p₀
   168	    rw [hq₁B, hq₁]
   169	  have hfB : phi₁ f ∉ q₁B.asIdeal := by
   170	    intro hmem
   171	    apply hf
   172	    have : f ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.comap phi₁.toRingHom q₁B).asIdeal := hmem
   173	    rwa [hq₁push] at this
   174	  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : q₁B ∈ Set.range
   175	      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B₁ S)) := by
   176	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range S (phi₁ f)]
   177	    exact hfB
   178	  have hqB : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B S) q = p := by
   179	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq B B₁ S, PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp]
   180	    change PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B B₁)
   181	      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B₁ S) q) = p
   182	    rw [hq, hq₁B]
   183	  let algA₂S : Algebra (Localization.Away f) S := phi₂.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   184	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away f) S := algA₂S
   185	  letI : SMul (Localization.Away f) S := algA₂S.toSMul
   186	  haveI towerKA₂S : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) S :=
   187	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (phi₂.commutes x).symm
   188	  let psi₀ : (↑B₀) →ₐ[k] S :=
